title: C validate_ipv6_transport_lengths reads packet[4..5] before any pkt_len >= 40 check (latent OOB, unreachable via public API)
description: Confirmed by ASan during the robustness codereview pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-njdx. lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_helpers.c:440-441 reads the payload-length field via ipv6_payload_len (read_be16, schc_helpers.c:82/100) and computes pkt_len - IPV6_HDR_LEN before any pkt_len >= IPV6_HDR_LEN guard: a direct call with pkt_len=4 triggers a stack-buffer-overflow READ of size 1. Unreachable in production (the only caller lichen_schc_compress guards pkt_len < IPV6_HDR_LEN at schc.c:542), but the validator should be self-defending. Fix: add a pkt_len < IPV6_HDR_LEN guard at the top of validate_ipv6_transport_lengths; cover with a direct-call unit test in the host C suite.
